name: open-dynamic-workflows
description: Dynamic workflow orchestration for ZCode — fan a deterministic script out across many zcode subagents. Provides a `workflow` tool, an authoring skill, and a `/workflows` command. A faithful, model-agnostic reimplementation of Claude Code's Workflow runtime.

description_i18n.en: Dynamic workflow orchestration for ZCode — fan a deterministic script out across many zcode subagents. Provides a `workflow` tool, an authoring skill, and a `/workflows` command. A faithful, model-agnostic reimplementation of Claude Code's Workflow runtime.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向 ZCode 的动态工作流编排——把一段确定性脚本扇出成大量 zcode 子 agent。提供 `workflow` 工具、编写 skill 和 `/workflows` 命令。Claude Code Workflow 运行时的忠实、模型无关的复刻。

executor.title: Default worker executor
executor.description: The CLI executor each agent() in a workflow spawns. 'zcode' (default) uses the user's installed zcode. Workflows name executors per-node; this sets which are available.
